title: Anesthesia handover documentation

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports transport with appropriate monitoring and support, arrival re-evaluation, verbal report, and documented transfer status.
user_facing_items.population: Patients who receive general anesthesia, regional anesthesia, or monitored anesthesia care.
user_facing_items.setting: PACU or equivalent postanesthesia recovery location.
restrictions: Exact for transfer, arrival evaluation, handover, recovery monitoring and records, discharge criteria, and qualified discharge responsibility. It does not generate discharge or treatment decisions.
user_facing_items.rationale: The exact ASA standard supports transport, arrival re-evaluation, verbal handover, and documented status transfer to PACU or equivalent care.
